sections.title: Combine plans and obligations
sections.content: Use *ir a* + infinitive for a planned action and *tener que* + infinitive for a personal obligation.

sections.title: Plans and obligations
rows: I have to prepare the bag.

items.spanish: Voy a viajar y tengo que preparar la maleta.
items.english: I am going to travel and I have to pack the suitcase.

items.spanish: Voy a trabajar, pero tengo que llegar temprano.
items.english: I am going to work, but I have to arrive early.

items.spanish: Vamos a viajar y tenemos que reservar el hotel.
items.english: We are going to travel and we have to book the hotel.

sections.content: The two structures have different meanings: *voy a...* describes a plan; *tengo que...* describes a personal obligation.
